name: artifact_list
description: The artifact templates you can make with no network (slalom, hoop_course), the artifacts already on this headset, and which one is open.

name: artifact_create
description: Make an artifact from a template and open it. 'Make me a slalom' is template slalom (for a truck); 'make me a hoop course' is template hoop_course (standing hoops for a drone). The headset lays the course out on free floor in the person's real room (a slalom goes around the couch if there is one; hoops also have to fit under the ceiling), so never make up positions. If the result has 'say', tell the person that in your own words (the course had to shrink, there's no couch, or the ceiling wasn't in the scan). If it's awaiting_approval, ask them to tap Allow. A no_free_floor, no_headroom or no_room_data error explains itself: pass it on.

inputs.description: Optional starting values. Slalom: {"gates": 6, "spacing_m": 1.0}, gates 3 to 12, spacing 0.6 to 2.0 m. Hoop course: {"hoops": 5, "spacing_m": 1.2}, hoops 3 to 10, spacing 0.6 to 2.0 m.

name: artifact_open
description: Open an artifact that's on this headset by id. A course reuses its saved layout in this room, so runs compare fairly.

name: artifact_relayout
description: Lay the open course out again in this room, for when furniture moved or the person wants it somewhere else. The old layout and its runs are kept, but new runs won't compare like for like with old ones.

name: artifact_run
description: Arm a scored run on the open artifact (or open it first). The Thing entering the start zone starts the timer; finishing through every gate or hoop, crashing or rolling over, missing one, or timing out writes a run record and attaches it to the notebook.

name: artifact_compare
description: Put run metrics side by side. If runs isn't given, the two newest. Runs on a different course are labelled; never treat those as a clean comparison.
